history.summary: A 5BR (1776 sqft) at ELTA, the 501-unit MCL Land/CSC 99yr new launch at Clementi Ave 1 (TOP ~2028), priced at $3.78M / $2128 PSF — below ELTA's ~$2,537 PSF launch average because big units price lower per sqft. ELTA is a strong, well-located D05 project, but a $3.78M large unit sits in a very thin buyer pool, which is the dominant exit risk.
history.rating_rationale: ELTA has real fundamentals: D05/One-North-adjacent, 501 units (liquid project), MCL Land/CSC, near Clementi MRT interchange and top schools (Nan Hua, NUS High), and it sold ~65% on launch weekend at ~$2,537 PSF — so $2128 PSF on this large unit is genuinely below average. But $3.78M is well above the liquid sweet spot; large 5BR units have a narrow buyer base and slow resale, and as a new launch there's no resale track record. The fundamentals say Buy on the project, the quantum/unit-type says Neutral on this specific listing.
